lens: Cross-topic visual identity and coherent synthesis: each subject should have its own recognizable silhouette, semantic action and motion logic, within shared typography and controls. Scores use semantic 35, distinction 25, choreography 20 and usability 20; choreography is judged from authored source, not watched animation.
evidence: Read JURY.md, manifest.json, the equal production contract, all four topic briefs, all twenty rationale.json files and the twenty entry modules through their SVG/CSS, phase implementations and choice logic. Inspected actual Chrome still contact sheets for pid, calc, ontology and tbe, plus larger individual stills for P2, P3, C2, O5 and T5. Executed source render functions to inspect phase/choice text for the calc, ontology and tbe modules. The observed screenshots show the desktop English explore state with the default choice; other phases, alternate choices and finite motion behavior are source-inferred. Read verification.json reporting 20 submissions and 10 or 15 renders per module. The organizer separately reports 200 desktop EN/KO default-state outer-bound checks without overflow; that does not establish internal label spacing, mobile readability or animation acceptance. No browser animation, physical device, human-user research or other juror ballot was inspected.

Small rotated sheets and a seal can lose clarity at reduced width, and its paper metaphor needs separation from the TBE final.

pid.synthesis: Create a registered route specimen with a stable plan-view backbone: introduce a compact physical pump/valve cue reworked from P2, flatten it onto P3 registration marks, and expose P4 named connection rings directly beneath their actual ports. A single redline branch then joins before and after the valve; reuse P1 construction guides only to explain the endpoints. Let a narrow P5 calculation/review film lift away to show the new unresolved obligation, then re-register without hiding the original or the pending state. Keep the selected topology identical in explore, review and outcome. This is a new drawing-to-connection composition, not a complete P3 or P2 reuse; reserve paper prose review for TBE, use line geometry as the P&ID identity, and avoid fluid-speed claims or a generic circular conclusion.

The fixed downstream 0.12 head and lumping of resistance into a throat need a visible conceptual boundary; the final candidate sheet loses the selected numeric state.

Rework C2 transparent columns into a simple head witness; let C3 loss terraces briefly account for the head drop using the same datum, with their illustrative allocation stated beside them. The apparatus then resolves into a full-width pump/system plot using C1 synchronized numeric/geometry logic and C4 ghost-baseline comparison. Start with a few C5 unit-bearing inputs and use its explicitly assumed sensitivity interval only in the review phase. Keep the selected Q, the unchanged pump and the open OEM/human obligations visible into the outcome. Do not stack a dial, landscape, vessels and plot simultaneously; the new composition should transform one physical balance into one mathematical balance, with an identity distinct from P&ID connection drawings.

tbe.synthesis: Build a clause review desk with a deliberate relay embedded in the document itself. Begin with a single enlarged T2 requirement/reply/evidence row, preserving T4 original and working-proof layers. A selected clause strip becomes the T5 baton; a T1 empty evidence footprint physically interrupts its path. When relevant evidence is linked, rework T3 feed/interlock into a restrained document-slot action that releases only an outlined draft, then stop separately at human applicability review. Missing evidence must remain a clarification in every later phase. Finish with original, change and rationale visible on the same review desk. This recombination keeps document comparison as TBE identity and borrows the relay causal logic without adopting the complete T5 scene or the entire press machine.
